import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class FlowGraph {
        static class Edge {
            int to, flow, cap, cost, orig;
            Edge(int to, int flow, int cap, int cost, int orig) {
                this.to = to;
                this.flow = flow;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.cost = cost;
                this.orig = orig;
            }
        }

        int n, source, sink;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> adj;
        ArrayList<Edge> edges;

        FlowGraph(int n, int source, int sink) {
            this.n = n;
            this.source = source;
            this.sink = sink;
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        int addEdge(int a, int b, int cap, int cost) {
            int id = edges.size();
            adj.get(a).add(id);
            edges.add(new Edge(b, 0, cap, cost, cost));
            adj.get(b).add(id + 1);
            edges.add(new Edge(a, 0, 0, -cost, -cost));
            return id;
        }

        void bellmanFord() {
            int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
            int[] dist = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            dist[source] = 0;

            for (int rep = 0; rep < n; rep++) {
                boolean changed = false;
                for (int id = 0; id < edges.size(); id++) {
                    int v = edges.get(id ^ 1).to;
                    int u = edges.get(id).to;
                    Edge e = edges.get(id);
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && dist[v] != INF && dist[u] > dist[v] + e.cost) {
                        dist[u] = dist[v] + e.cost;
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
                if (!changed) break;
            }

            for (int id = 0; id < edges.size(); id++) {
                int v = edges.get(id ^ 1).to;
                int u = edges.get(id).to;
                if (dist[v] < INF && dist[u] < INF) {
                    edges.get(id).cost += dist[v] - dist[u];
                }
            }
        }

        int[] dijkstra() {
            int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
            int[] dist = new int[n];
            int[] prev = new int[n];
            int[] maxf = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            Arrays.fill(prev, -1);
            dist[source] = 0;
            prev[source] = -2;
            maxf[source] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;

            PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
            pq.offer(new int[]{0, source});

            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                int[] cur = pq.poll();
                int d = cur[0], v = cur[1];
                if (d != dist[v]) continue;

                for (int id : adj.get(v)) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(id);
                    if (e.flow < e.cap) {
                        int nd = d + e.cost;
                        if (nd < dist[e.to]) {
                            dist[e.to] = nd;
                            prev[e.to] = id;
                            maxf[e.to] = Math.min(maxf[v], e.cap - e.flow);
                            pq.offer(new int[]{nd, e.to});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            int last = prev[sink];
            if (last == -1) return new int[]{0, 0};

            int extra = maxf[sink];
            int atcost = 0;

            for (int id = last; id != -2; id = prev[edges.get(id ^ 1).to]) {
                edges.get(id).flow += extra;
                edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= extra;
                atcost += edges.get(id).orig;
            }

            for (int id = 0; id < edges.size(); id++) {
                int v = edges.get(id ^ 1).to;
                int u = edges.get(id).to;
                if (prev[v] != -1 && prev[u] != -1) {
                    edges.get(id).cost += dist[v] - dist[u];
                }
            }

            return new int[]{extra, atcost};
        }

        int[] mfmc() {
            int flow = 0, cost = 0;

            boolean needBellman = false;
            for (Edge e : edges) {
                if (e.flow > 0 && e.cost < 0) {
                    needBellman = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (needBellman) bellmanFord();

            while (true) {
                int[] r = dijkstra();
                if (r[0] == 0) break;
                flow += r[0];
                cost += r[0] * r[1];
            }

            return new int[]{flow, cost};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        final int maxTime = 120;
        int[] a = new int[K];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) a[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        ArrayList<Integer>[] e = new ArrayList[n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) e[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            e[x].add(y);
            e[y].add(x);
        }

        int nd = 0;
        int[][] to = new int[maxTime][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < maxTime; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
                to[i][j] = nd++;

        int S = nd++;
        int T = nd++;
        FlowGraph fg = new FlowGraph(nd, S, T);

        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++)
            fg.addEdge(S, to[0][a[i]], 1, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < maxTime; i++)
            fg.addEdge(to[i][1], T, K, c * i);

        for (int i = 0; i < maxTime - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int nb : e[j]) {
                    for (int z = 0; z <= 52; z++)
                        fg.addEdge(to[i][j], to[i + 1][nb], 1, d * (2 * z + 1));
                }
                fg.addEdge(to[i][j], to[i + 1][j], K, 0);
            }
        }

        int[] ans = fg.mfmc();
        System.out.println(ans[1]);
    }
}
